(Japanese: '''ハイドル''' ''Haidoru'') is a character from the [[Pokémon Try Adventure]] manga. He is a phantom thief as well as a recurring foe for [[Katsuya]] and his friends.

==Character==
Haidoru appears to take his job as a phantom thief seriously, especially when he yelled at {{p|Kecleon}} for interrupting him in his debut appearance. In later appearances, he has mellowed out a little.

==History==
Haidoru first appeared in [[TA10]] where he came out of one of the stone sculptures in the train museum. As Haidoru was about to get away with a {{p|Sudowoodo}} stone sculpture. The grappling hook he used accidentally destroyed some train tracks. With the help of [[Toki]]'s {{p|Snover}} and [[Katsuya]]'s {{p|Piplup}}, the tracks were restored to an icy path and Haidoru was left hanging when he used his grappling hook somewhere else.
